method: Every selected original Hebrew record and all annotations read before independently drafting. All TSW comparator verses read afterward. Every verse has an individually authored rationale. No synonym-substitution engine or change quota used.
qualification: Authoring reread by the drafting agent; not independent scholarly approval.
companion_impact: Quotations and bindings for changed chapters require later reconciliation. Companion not modified.
comparator_limitations: Normalized whole-verse overlap is triage only, not proof of fidelity, originality, or comprehension.
